scene: embedded, unchanged scene schema version 1; no external file references or executable expressions
numbers: finite JSON numbers only; no booleans, strings, implicit unit conversions, NaN or Infinity

force.semantics: qE or mg for an independent test probe; no probe feedback, source-source force or self-force

expectation.value_shape: exactly the result shape; no broadcasting
expectation.atol: finite nonnegative number in result units
expectation.meaning: authored reference check only, not independent correctness, solver tolerance or certified error bound

exit_codes.0: all evaluated requests and supplied expectations pass; or schema-only validation succeeds
exit_codes.1: one or more domain/numerical failures or failed expectations; detailed report retained
exit_codes.2: invalid input, unsupported request, or file I/O failure

validation_only: no field evaluation and no domain or accuracy certification
potential_references: unchanged sum of source references; endpoint difference can suffer cancellation
schema_note: This is a descriptive machine-readable contract, not a JSON Schema document. Runtime validation is authoritative.
